name: WrappingReview/ArrayInitializers.cs
note: Implemented: array initializers use csharp_wrap_array_initializer_style = chop_always. Review one element per line, including the closing delimiter.

name: WrappingReview/CollectionExpressions.cs
note: Implemented: collection expressions use csharp_wrap_list_pattern = chop_always. Compare the previous snapshot with the new layout.

name: WrappingReview/ObjectArrays.cs
note: New coverage: each object in the array has its own line. Array elements and object members use separate wrapping settings. Compare the new fixture input with the result.

name: WrappingReview/ObjectInitializers.cs
note: New coverage: csharp_wrap_object_and_collection_initializer_style = chop_always puts each object member on its own line. Compare the new fixture input with the result.

name: WrappingReview/CollectionInitializers.cs
note: New coverage: traditional collection initializers also use csharp_wrap_object_and_collection_initializer_style = chop_always. Compare the new fixture input with the result.

name: WrappingReview/ListPatterns.cs
note: New coverage: the JetBrains csharp_wrap_list_pattern setting also applies to list patterns. Review this shared scope alongside collection expressions.

name: WrappingReview/Calls.cs
note: Already supported: a long argument list wraps at the configured width. Use this as a reference when judging other expressions.

name: WrappingReview/ConditionalExpressions.cs
note: Implemented: csharp_wrap_ternary_expr_style = chop_if_long and csharp_wrap_before_ternary_opsigns = true split long ternaries before ? and :. Compare the previous snapshot with the new layout; short expressions stay compact.

name: WrappingReview/ShortConditional.cs
note: New coverage: the same chop_if_long policy keeps this short ternary on one line. An identical input and result is intentional.

name: WrappingReview/NestedConditional.cs
note: New coverage: the long outer ternary wraps before ? and :. After that, the inner ternary fits on its line and stays compact; the short method parameter list also stays together.

name: WrappingReview/Patterns.cs
note: Implemented: csharp_wrap_property_pattern = chop_if_long puts each property of a long pattern on its own line. Compare the previous snapshot: the short method signature now stays together. List patterns have their own setting.

name: WrappingReview/ShortPattern.cs
note: New coverage: chop_if_long keeps this short property pattern on one line. An identical input and result is intentional.

name: WrappingReview/NestedPatterns.cs
note: New coverage: the long outer property pattern wraps first. The short Address pattern stays compact, while the long Account pattern also expands.

name: WrappingReview/Queries.cs
note: Implemented: csharp_wrap_linq_expressions = chop_if_long wraps long or multiline queries. csharp_wrap_before_linq_expression = true puts the first clause on a new line. Short queries stay compact.

name: WrappingReview/ShortCallMultiline.cs
note: Implemented: csharp_keep_existing_linebreaks = false joins safe call-list boundaries when the complete line fits max_line_length. Compare the previous multiline result with the compact call.

name: WrappingReview/ShortCallSingleLine.cs
note: Implemented: the same policy keeps this short call on one line. Its result now matches ShortCallMultiline.cs; unchanged output is intentional.

name: WrappingReview/SwitchExpressions.cs
note: Implemented: csharp_wrap_switch_expression = chop_if_long puts each arm of a long or multiline switch on its own line. The short method signature now stays together.

name: WrappingReview/Tuples.cs
note: Implemented: pnfmt_csharp_wrap_tuple_style = chop_if_long puts each element of a long or multiline tuple on its own line. The closing parenthesis stays with the last element.

name: WrappingReview/StructuralAttributes.xml
note: Already supported: attributes on a structural element wrap at the configured width. Compare with the protected text-bearing cases.

name: WrappingReview/AttributesOnDifferentLines.xml
note: Already supported: xml_attribute_style = on_different_lines puts each attribute on its own line.

name: WrappingReview/AttributesOnSingleLine.xml
note: Already supported: xml_attribute_style = on_single_line joins short attribute lists.

name: WrappingReview/TextAttributes.xml
note: Decide: should attributes on text-bearing elements wrap while their text remains byte-for-byte preserved? Currently the complete subtree is protected.

name: WrappingReview/MixedContentAttributes.xml
note: Decide: should start-tag attributes wrap around mixed content? Spaces around inline elements must retain their meaning.

name: WrappingReview/TagSpelling.xml
note: Decide: normalize spacing around =, quotes, and self-closing delimiters, or preserve the original tag spelling?

name: WrappingReview/TextAndStructuralContainers.xaml
note: Decide: should text-bearing controls wrap their attributes like structural containers, while preserving all text content?

name: WrappingReview/ShortQuery.cs
note: New coverage: chop_if_long keeps a short single-line query compact, even when wrap_before_linq_expression is enabled.

name: WrappingReview/ShortSwitch.cs
note: New coverage: chop_if_long keeps a short switch expression on one line.

name: WrappingReview/ShortTuple.cs
note: New coverage: pnfmt_csharp_wrap_tuple_style = chop_if_long keeps short tuples compact.

name: WrappingReview/QueryContinuations.cs
note: New coverage: a long query wraps its clauses and continuation, including group, into, orderby, and select.

name: WrappingReview/NestedCalls.cs
note: New coverage: inner calls compact first, then the outer call joins when its complete line fits the width. Multiline argument contents and comments remain protected.

name: WrappingReview/TupleTypes.cs
note: New coverage: tuple types use the same PNFmt tuple-wrapping setting as tuple values and deconstruction variables. Names and types are preserved.

name: WrappingReview/NestedSwitchExpressions.cs
note: New coverage: the outer switch wraps first; a short nested switch stays compact.
